name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. He initially studied engineering, but a chance encounter at a local Santiago rally ignited a passion for the high-octane world. Realizing his analytical skills could be applied to risk assessment and security protocols, he transitioned, working his way up from trackside marshal to security consultant for smaller racing teams. His reputation for meticulousness and innovative security solutions caught the eye of AF Corse.

At AF Corse, Ricardo is known for his proactive approach. He believes in anticipating potential threats and implementing preventative measures, rather than simply reacting to incidents. His demanding nature stems from a deep-seated commitment to ensuring the safety of the team and its assets. He constantly seeks to improve security protocols and stay ahead of evolving threats, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is a lean man with a serious demeanor, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with security checklists and risk assessments.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his glasses, even when they appear spotless.
Speaks in a calm, measured tone, even when under pressure.
